The protesters also demanded that the recruitment examination be postponed by at least a month to give candidates adequate preparation time.

stories.title: AI helps us spot possible lung cancer, says medic
stories.summary: At the general hospitals in Kettering and Northampton, AI software reviews patients' scans, highlighting subtle abnormalities that would be difficult to see otherwise. Cornilius Mushambi, consultant radiographer, said it "increased confidence" in the final judgement made by a clinician, but stressed it did not replace human expertise. With NHS England funding, the technology was introduced in November 2024 and has helped staff examine 62,661 chest X-rays.

stories.title: USA joint bid and UK confirmed as 2031 and 2035 FIFA Women's World Cup hosts
stories.summary: FIFA on Monday (November 23, 2026) confirmed that a joint bid led by the United States will host the expanded, 48-team Women's World Cup in 2031, while the United Kingdom will host the following edition in 2035.

stories.title: Priyansh Arya rewrites SMAT record books with 181, hits 19 sixes
stories.summary: Delhi skipper Priyansh Arya rewrote the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy (SMAT) record books with a breathtaking 68-ball 181 (7x4, 19x6) against Tamil Nadu in a Group-B clash at the Daly College ground in Indore on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), registering the highest individual score and hitting the most sixes in an innings in the tournament’s history.

stories.title: Priyansh Arya Smashes 181 Against Tamil Nadu To Break KL Rahul's Record For Highest T20 Score By An Indian In Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy
stories.summary: Indore: Delhi and Punjab Kings (PBKS) star Priyansh Arya overtook Indian superstar KL Rahul's record for highest T20 individual score by an Indian during the Syed Mushtaq Ali clash against Tamil Nadu on Tuesday.

stories.title: International Emmy Awards 2026: Vir Das, Real Kashmir Football Club miss out; Full winners list
stories.summary: India had a notable presence at the 54th International Emmy Awards, with Vir Das and SonyLIV's Real Kashmir Football Club representing the country in the competitive categories. However, both missed out on top honours. Adding to India's presence at the global event, actor Vijay Sethupathi made his debut as a presenter at the prestigious ceremony in New York City.

stories.title: D Gukesh vs Javokhir Sindarov: Fortitude meets form in battle for world chess crown
stories.summary: For a match that will decide the World Chess Championship – the biggest title in chess – the buzz has been awfully muted. But starting Tuesday, two grandmasters with a combined age of just 40 will go at each other in a best-of-14 classical games affair, in the hushed confines of a library-museum in Geneva, surrounded by shelves of rare books and manuscripts.

stories.title: Is Hamilton and Leclerc's Ferrari partnership sustainable? F1 Q&A
stories.summary: Max Verstappen triumphed in a thrilling Las Vegas Grand Prix ahead of the McLarens of Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri. There were 34 lead changes across the 50 laps of racing as Dutchman Verstappen held off attacks from Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli and George Russell, plus his Red Bull team-mate Isack Hadjar.

stories.title: The teacher's son, comeback kid and a teenage champion: India's World Tennis League season 5 squad
stories.summary: Eight players. Eight journeys. One stage. From overcoming career-threatening injuries and leaving home as teenagers to winning Asian Games gold and breaking through on the international circuit, India's contingent at the World Tennis League (WTL) Season 5 brings together stories that go well beyond the tennis court.

stories.title: Asia Cup Rising Stars: How Can India Reach The Semifinals? All Scenarios Explained
stories.summary: India A will look to seal its place in the semifinals of the ACC Men’s Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 when it takes on the United Arab Emirates (UAE) in its final Group B fixture in Doha on Tuesday, November 24. The Tilak Varma-led side suffered a 48-run defeat to Pakistan A in its previous outing, missing the opportunity to secure an early qualification.

stories.title: Asia Cup Rising Stars: UAE elects to bat against India ‘A’
stories.summary: United Arab Emirates won the toss and opted to bat against India in their final Group B match of the Asia Cup Rising Stars 50-over tournament here on Tuesday. India A have made three changes to the playing XI, bringing in Prabhsimran Singh, Harsh Dubey and Arshad Khan in place of Ayush Badoni, Vipraj Nigam and Prince Yadav.

stories.title: No Emmy For India! Manav Kaul, Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub's Real Kashmir Football Club Loses To France In Drama Category
stories.summary: India failed to secure a win at the 54th International Emmy Awards 2026, held on November 23 in New York City (November 24 in India). The ceremony, hosted by Michael Urie, saw India's sports drama Real Kashmir Football Club lose in the Drama category to France's historical drama series Careme.

stories.title: D Gukesh on World Chess Championship: I’m not here to defend, I’m here to win
stories.summary: Defending champion Gukesh is clear how he doesn’t want to look at the World Chess Championship that begins on Tuesday. “I’m not here to defend anything…I’m here to win it all over again.” Gukesh said at the opening press conference in Geneva on Sunday. “Sindarov has just been very consistent and in very good form.

stories.title: De Villiers claims ball-tampering from first 2018 Test
stories.summary: Former South Africa batter AB de Villiers has alleged Australia were ball-tampering from the first match of their controversial 2018 Test series. Australia captain Steve Smith, vice-captain David Warner and batter Cameron Bancroft received long-term bans for their roles in using sandpaper to alter the ball during the third Test in Cape Town.

stories.title: Fury reveals schizophrenia diagnosis
stories.summary: Tyson Fury says he was diagnosed with schizophrenia soon after his world title win over Wladimir Klitschko in 2015. British heavyweight Fury, 38, says he heard voices in his head threatening to hurt him and his family. In a documentary which will be released by Netflix on Friday, Fury and wife Paris describe how he was diagnosed after being admitted to hospital with a suspected heart attack in June 2016.

stories.title: Fisher replaces injured Tickner in New Zealand's Test squad
stories.summary: Pacer Blair Tickner has been ruled out of the second Test against India with a right hamstring injury. He suffered the setback during training in Wellington and will now receive further assessments in Christchurch. Once the final outcome is determined, his expected return-to-play timeline will be set.

stories.title: India tour of New Zealand: New Zealand vs India first Test in Wellington ends in draw
stories.summary: Leeds 2025 , Colombo (SSC) 2026 and Wellington 2026. Thrice in the last 18 months, India has entered Day 5 of an overseas Test match eyeing a rare Test win away from home. But on all three occasions, India couldn’t rise to the occasion and return with 12 points on offer for a win in the World Test Championship (WTC).

stories.title: Sandpapergate scandal: AB de Villiers makes new claim about Australian ball-tampering
stories.summary: Former South African batsman AB de Villiers has alleged Australia engaged in ball-tampering from the first match of their 2018 "Sandpapergate" tour of South Africa. de Villiers alleged in a post on his YouTube channel that the ball-tampering, which culminated in Cameron Bancroft being caught using sandpaper in the third Test in Cape Town, actually began in the first Test in Durban.

stories.title: Shubman Gill reveals why Team India cancelled planned activity after Wellington Test
stories.summary: India's bowlers had to put in a long shift during the drawn first Test against New Zealand in Wellington. India captain Shubman Gill said the players deserved a break after such a demanding effort. "Our bowlers have put in so many overs, we will definitely take them (out for a dinner).

stories.title: Had no idea that RCB would retain me: Yash Dayal vows strong IPL 2027 performance
stories.summary: And Dayal himself saw it as a shocker. Speaking to Times Of India, the UP pacer said he had no idea about being a part of the side moving forward next season. Dayal said he aims to repay the faith with a sensational campaign in 2027 for RCB.

stories.title: WTC Final race: 22 Tests, four contenders – who will make the cut?
stories.summary: A total of 22 Tests remain in the 2025-27 World Test Championship cycle, with the race for the top two spots heading towards a thrilling finish. South Africa, Australia and New Zealand occupy the top three positions, with India needing a strong finish and favourable results elsewhere. 1.

stories.title: 'I do not see such potential in Gukesh': Grandmaster's brutal verdict
stories.summary: Denis Lazavik has made a strong statement ahead of the World Chess Championship 2026, backing Javokhir Sindarov to beat defending champion D Gukesh. "I do not see such potential in Gukesh. Neither in his current play, nor in his general human qualities. 'I would not count on any long and equal fight'Lazavik believes Sindarov is in better form and has the ability to control the match.

stories.title: From 60 overs of hell to 15 of charity: Shubman Gill still has work to do as captain
stories.summary: On August 16, 2021, when Virat Kohli sent this message to his team on the final day of the Lord's Test, it quickly became iconic. And for good reason. India didn't just listen to their captain; they went out and delivered on his words. England were happy to settle for a draw, but Kohli wanted nothing less than a win.

stories.title: 49ers win in Mexico and Bills stay top - NFL week 11
stories.summary: The San Francisco 49ers and Buffalo Bills remain the pacesetters in each conference of the NFL after both won again. The 49ers beat the Minnesota Vikings in the last of a record nine international games this season to take their record to 9-1. They lead the way in the NFC, with divisional rivals the Chicago Bears and Detroit Lions next best on 8-2.

stories.title: NorthEast United vs SC Delhi — Manipur set to host ISL match for first time
stories.summary: The Indian Super League (ISL) is set to make its debut in Manipur when NorthEast United takes on SC Delhi at the Khuman Lampak Main Stadium in Imphal on Tuesday. NorthEast United, a club representing eight states, usually plays its matches at the Indira Gandhi Athletic Stadium in Guwahati.

stories.title: Bembem, Bentla, Ancheri, Coutinho emerge winners in AIFF SOM polls
stories.summary: Former India players Bembem Devi, Bentla D'Coth, Jo Paul Ancheri and Bruno Coutinho were on Monday elected as four Sportspersons of Merit (SOMs) to become members of the General Body of the All India Football Federation (AIFF) for the December 20 polls. Ancheri and Coutinho won the two seats for male SOMs.

stories.title: Shubman Gill on leaving out Mohammed Siraj for Wellington Test: ‘Each player goes through a phase when he's not at his peak'
stories.summary: India captain Shubman Gill on Monday said that he had a conversation with pacer Mohammed Siraj before eventually leaving him out of the playing XI for the Wellington Test against New Zealand. Akash Deep, Anshul Kamboj and Prasidh Krishna played ahead of Siraj at the Basin Reserve, and the move attracted criticism from several quarters.

stories.title: `Why these double standards?`: Diljit Dosanjh questions song restrictions
stories.summary: Dr Punditrao Dharennavar, Associate Professor of Sociology at PGGC-46, Chandigarh, who sought restrictions over Diljit Dosanjh singing Patiala Peg, 5 Taara and Jeeb Vicho Feem Labbiya has rejected allegations of "double standards" over song lyrics. He has said that his objections are not limited to Diljit but extend to singers whose songs promote alcohol, drugs and gun culture.

stories.title: Who’s that one man not invited to the big fat Bihar wedding of Anant Singh’s daughter?
stories.summary: Kumar, who recently secured a fourth consecutive term in the Bihar Legislative Council, says he couldn’t be happier about being left out. “Thank God for it. Associating with such people is truly detrimental,” Kumar told ThePrint in Patna, responding to Singh’s public declaration that he would not invite him to the wedding, scheduled for 25 November in his ancestral village of Nadwan.

stories.title: Explainer-Mexico nabs yet another top drug lord, but history of ‘Kingpin Strategy’ mixed
stories.summary: Chapo Isidro was considered one of the leaders of the Beltrán Leyva Organization, a former ally of the powerful Sinaloa Cartel that later became one of its top rivals. His capture is the latest in a string of arrests of high-profile suspected drug traffickers as Mexico — under intense pressure from US President Donald Trump — has decisively returned to the so-called Kingpin Strategy.

stories.title: 8th Pay Commission: Civilian defence staff seek 6% annual increment, OPS and 50% DA merger— 13 key demands explained
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Pratiraksha Mazdoor Sangh (BPMS), an all-India federation of civilian defence employees recognised by the Ministry of Defence, has submitted a fresh list of around 73 demands to the 8th Central Pay Commission (CPC), seeking substantial improvements in salaries, pensions and service benefits for central government employees, particularly defence civilian personnel.

stories.title: Who is Sugandha Hiremath? Meet businesswoman at centre of Kalyani family’s ₹1 lakh crore ancestral wealth dispute
stories.summary: Sugandha Hiremath, sister of Bharat Forge chairman Baba Kalyani, is at the centre of a high-profile inheritance dispute involving the Kalyani family’s ancestral wealth , estimated at more than ₹ 1 lakh crore. The legal battle, which has dragged on across judicial forums, involves claims over family assets, properties and stakes in companies linked to the Pune-based industrial family.

stories.title: Who Was Dr Ram Narayan Shah? A Look At The Veteran Ayurvedic Physician’s Career And Credentials
stories.summary: Dr Ram Narayan Shah, father of Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah, popularly known as Balen, was a senior Ayurvedic physician who spent decades working in Nepal’s public healthcare system. Beyond his association with the Prime Minister, Shah had an established professional career, holding several important positions in the country’s Ayurvedic medical institutions.

stories.title: Why BJP is keen to associate Paschim with Banga in its new rechristening exercise of the State? | Explained
stories.summary: On November 23, 2026 West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari said that the State will be referred to as ‘Paschim Banga’ in all languages including English. Mr. Adhikari said that the State cabinet has passed the proposal and a new resolution to the effect will be tabled in the State Assembly on December 9.

stories.title: Who is Harpreet Singh Bhatia? Former India U-19 cricketer scores fifty for UAE against India A
stories.summary: Harpreet Singh Bhatia, once regarded as one of India’s promising young batting talents, found himself up against his former cricketing countrymen on Tuesday, scoring a half-century off 76 balls for the UAE against India A in a must-win Group B encounter at the Men’s Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 in Doha.

stories.title: Why has Yemen’s offensive against the Houthis in al-Bayda stalled?
stories.summary: When Yemen’s internationally recognised government launched a counteroffensive against the Houthis in the strategically important al-Bayda province in September, it appeared to open a major new front against the group. Al-Bayda, a province in central Yemen, has become one of the flashpoints since the Yemeni government launched its response to a series of Houthi advances on the coast and around Taiz in September.

stories.title: Mint explainer: Why India's TReDS platforms have set sights on global markets
stories.summary: Indian invoice-discounting platform M1xchange, which helps small businesses get paid early against unpaid invoices, is in talks with foreign banks in Russia and Brazil to set up local trade receivables discounting systems (TReDS), Mint reported on 23 November. The move follows the Jaipur Consensus, a diplomatic agreement reached during India's presidency of the BRICS bloc.

stories.title: Who Was Prabhjot Singh Mann? California-Based Muay Thai Fighter Passes Away After Suffering Head Injury During Tournament In Spain
stories.summary: Prab Mann/Instagram California-based Muay Thai fighter Prabhjot Singh Mann has died after suffering a severe head injury during a tournament in Madrid, Spain. The fighter sustained the injury on November 7 and was rushed to a local hospital, where he was admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU) for treatment.

stories.title: Why has the Musafirkhana building linked to Dawood Ibrahim been in court for 23 years? | Explained
stories.summary: The controversy revolving around the demolition of Haji Ismail Haji Habib Musafirkhana, a building located on Pakmodia Street in Mumbai’s Bhendi Bazaar and associated with gangster Dawood Ibrahim, has once again reached the Bombay High Court. Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) cited the ‘dangerously dilapidated’ condition of the building as a reason for demolition.

stories.title: Are you bigger than CM? Cops snap at UP woman during convoy movement
stories.summary: The clip, circulating on social media, shows the woman requesting permission to cross the road while police personnel manage barricades during Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's convoy movement. The officer was heard telling her, “ Mukhyamantri se badh ke ho tum? )." The woman's repeated pleas and the officer's response have since become the focus of online discussions.

stories.title: Are banks open or closed today? Check state-wise list of upcoming holidays
stories.summary: Banks in several cities across India will remain closed on Tuesday, November 24, on account of Guru Nanak Jayanti. Bank holidays vary across states and are determined by the RBI. Internet banking, mobile banking, UPI and ATM services are generally available on bank holidays.

stories.title: WhatsApp Web advisory: What the risks are and why govt recommends logging out of a session | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The National Cybercrime Threat Analytics Unit of the Indian Cybercrime Coordination Centre (I4C), which is part of the Union home ministry, issued an advisory (TAU/ADV/021) last week on the safe use of WhatsApp Web . It said a logged-in WhatsApp Web session “may, under certain circumstances, be misused” to get into a person’s account.

stories.title: From kala pani to Rikers, history of island prisons and the waters used to lock people in | HT Explainers
stories.summary: In Alexandre Dumas's The Count of Monte Cristo, the young sailor Edmond Dantès works out where the gendarmes are rowing him only as the boat nears the Château d'If, a fortress on a rock off Marseille. He protests that it holds only political prisoners, and asks whether there are any magistrates or judges there.

stories.title: Training vs inference: What’s the distinction at the heart of the Sarvam AI-China models controversy? | Explained
stories.summary: Sarvam AI has so far been known for developing its own Artificial Intelligence (AI) models with support from the government’s IndiaAI Mission. On November 16, the Bengaluru-based startup added another part to its business with the launch of Token Factory, a commercial service that gives businesses access to its own models and those developed by other companies, including Chinese firms.

stories.title: Everyday Explained: Why do wooden doors swell during monsoons and become difficult to shut?
stories.summary: From humidity to moisture absorption, an expert explains why wooden doors swell during monsoons and become difficult to shut. A door that closes effortlessly one day may suddenly start getting stuck in its frame when the rains arrive. This common monsoon inconvenience is not necessarily a sign of poor carpentry or damaged hinges.

stories.title: Can you fix a scratched CD? Here are your options
stories.summary: ArtCreationsDesignPhoto/Shutterstock : Preferred Source Google Discover Just like vinyl records before them, CDs are back . As strange as it may seem if you grew up with them, CDs have become a nostalgic icon of the joys of physical media — but they're also a reminder of why we all went digital in the first place.

stories.title: Who is Artemis Patrick? Meet Sephora CEO as she reveals why she once refused to work at the beauty company
stories.summary: Sephora CEO Artemis Patrick has revealed that she once rejected a job offer from the beauty retailer because she was unwilling to follow its strict dress code. The incident dates back to 1998, when Sephora was a small perfumery recently acquired by luxury group LVMH. At the time, the company required its employees to wear outfits in only three colours: black, white or grey.

stories.title: What happened to Jaylen Harrell? Police reveal alleged Uber driver assault before Titans star’s crash
stories.summary: Tennessee Titans defensive end Jaylen Harrell is facing questions after a serious car accident in Tampa, Florida, left him hospitalized with major injuries. According to the Tampa Police Department, the 24-year-old allegedly assaulted his Uber driver while riding in the back seat on Friday morning, November 20. Police say the driver lost control after the reported incident, hitting another vehicle before crashing into a utility pole.

stories.title: What next after COP31: Countries return to table at UN's Bonn talks in June 2027 | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The United Nations’ mid-year climate meetings in Bonn in June 2027 are the first formal chance for governments to return to the disputes over fossil fuels and money for poorer countries that left COP31 without a deal, five months before the next summit in Ethiopia.

stories.title: Is air pollution putting India’s frontline workers at risk? | In Focus Podcast
stories.summary: With the onset of winter, air pollution levels in Indian cities have touched alarming highs once again. While discussions around air pollution often centre on soaring AQI levels, smog and measures to curb vehicular emissions, what tends to get overlooked is its disproportionate impact on the most vulnerable groups, particularly those whose jobs expose them to polluted air for prolonged periods.

stories.title: India's first AI-enabled drug-testing van deployed at Worli Racecourse concert in Mumbai
stories.summary: Amid growing scrutiny of drug consumption at music events, the Anti-Narcotics Cell's (ANC) new AI-enabled forensic van was deployed at a concert at Worli Racecourse on Sunday. The vans are equipped to conduct preliminary drug screening at the scene. The technology can provide an immediate preliminary indication of drug consumption.

stories.title: Mumbai Book Festival 2026: A complete guide to unique events this week
stories.summary: Bibliophiles in the suburbs have much to cheer at the inaugural edition of the Mumbai Book Festival 2026. It’s being organised by National Book Trust, Ministry of Education, Government of Maharashtra, BMC, and University of Mumbai and runs from today till November 29 at the sprawling Kalina campus of the University of Mumbai.
